## Welcome

This site contains teaching materials for understanding bias in data science and machine learning, developed for a university-level course.

## Course Modules

### [Collider Bias](Collider bias.html)
Learn about collider bias, how it occurs in data analysis, and strategies to identify and mitigate it.

### [Labels Bias](Labels bias.html)
Explore how bias can be introduced through labeling processes and its implications for fairness in machine learning.

---

## About This Course

These materials were developed as part of the FAIR2-PIT-UN initiative to teach responsible data science practices.
